artboards.title: Deltas: current app vs this design

annotations.text: THE FIVE LAYER PROPERTY PANELS, one system. Full spec: docs/panel-redesign/PANEL-REDESIGN-SPEC.md. L0 accordion bar; group order CONTENT / APPEARANCE / TRANSFORM / EFFECTS where it applies (Fill has no Transform; Canvas has SIZE + ACTIONS). One Transform module, one paint-slot module for every Fill / Border / Shadow / Background, one .asset row, one Opacity row, one Reset Effects footer, one Advanced disclosure per module. Source is always a dropdown. Every boolean is a toggle switch, label left, switch right-aligned to the value column. Concentric radii (8 / 6 / 4 / 3). The revert column is reserved on every ROW; block elements (assets, notes, buttons, footers) span full width. Property labels 11px. Values in editable fields.

WORKSPACE START CARD (#workspaceStart): the centred card on the canvas when nothing is loaded. Distinct from the sidebar Welcome panel to its left. Heading + one sentence, three stacked actions (Open image primary, New canvas, Open project), a dashed drop zone with the size limits. Warmer than a settings surface; still the app's tokens.

AUTO GLITTER WIZARD + LAYERS PANEL.

AUTO GLITTER (autoGlitterSettingsSection): the panel that needs a scroll region. Fixed-height flex column: a PINNED preview mode segmented, a SCROLL region holding Palette (style, colors, merge), Color Matches (a live status line + a list of region -> matched glitter rows, each with a swatch pair, name, match % and a Change chip) and Advanced (detail + two toggles), then a STICKY FOOTER with Cancel / Create N layers. The running spinner sits in a fixed-height status slot so it never reflows the list. Nothing inside the scroll region is a new primitive.

LAYERS PANEL (left side, brought to parity): same Y2K bar with an icon, 'Layers', a count, a New Layer action and a collapse chevron. A layer row is one card: drag dots, a 34px swatch, name + type meta (+ a Masked / Locked badge), then visibility and lock icon buttons. States: active (accent border + tint), selected, is-hidden (dimmed), is-locked (no drag handle). A bottom bar of add / clone / go-to / delete icon buttons in the chrome.

Open: whether the layers list should adopt the same 6px card gap as the property panels' blocks (currently 4).

ASSET BROWSER. Three layouts, chosen by the collection.

GLITTER / STICKERS (category view): header (Back + title + count), search row, a 'By category / Show all' toggle, then a 2-up category folder grid. 'Show all' (its own artboard) is every item visible, grouped under category headers, nothing collapsed.

INSIDE A CATEGORY: the armed PICKER STRIP names the destination with a Done button; Back returns to the list; the active-filter summary has a real 'Clear all' pill; a 4-up asset grid, selected one outlined, animated items badged with a corner play glyph.

SEARCH + FILTER: the filter drawer: each group a .property-group-label over a chip row, hairline dividers, NO cards, NO fourth uppercase level, NO nested scroll. Round swatch chips for colours, pills for the rest. Clear all / Show N results pinned.

BRUSH TIPS: basic brushes listed flat, then Brush SETS as folders. A SET PAGE (its own artboard) is a back line, the set name, the Source & usage credit (label, byline, dot-separated meta, a collapsed Archival note, a links row), then the tips.

SHAPES: too small for folders. Every category shown, grouped under headers, always.

Grid columns are a container query (3 / 4 / 5-up).

CHANGELOG (newest first)

p22: GradientFill artboard - gradient as a 3rd Source mode of the paint-slot module. Figma model: a bar with stop HANDLES below it (pointer up) + midpoint diamonds; click-to-add / drag-off-to-remove, no Add/Remove buttons. Selected stop = ONE row (colour+alpha field, position as the value), not a sub-form. Only Reverse keeps a control. Type (Linear/Radial) + Angle (Radial hides it). Scale drops out; Opacity + Advanced unchanged. Nested editor -> sunk box (rule B).

p21: One collapse glyph everywhere - the down chevron (as the accordion bar + dropdowns use), rotated -90deg when collapsed. Replaced the module-header up-caret (19x) and the .disc right-arrow twisty (spec rule 17). No selection: Project drawn expanded (was collapsed) - nothing is shown collapsed unless its expanded state is on the sheet elsewhere. Brush-set Archival note drawn open, triangle -> chevron. Filter 'Search by name only' FIX: flex:1 was hitting the switch too (also a <span>) and stretching it - scoped to the label; switch now truly right-aligned. AutoGlitter iterated: Palette + Advanced lose their card boxes (rule B); Advanced is now the shared .disc disclosure (chevron + label + divider, collapsed by default), not a peer titled group. HANDOFF scope line corrected (layers panel + add-layer modal are in, parity only).

p20 (docs, no artboard change): all panel-redesign docs collected under docs/panel-redesign/ (PLAN + PROGRESS + HANDOFF + SPEC + ARTBOARD-DIFF). SPEC gained a component ledger (S12: kept / changed / new, and what renders each) and a behaviour add/change list (S13). New ARTBOARD-DIFF walks every artboard against its live app section with tagged deltas. PLAN S3 links look / build / per-artboard-diff. This Deltas artboard is the on-canvas summary; the doc is its full form.

p19: Consistency pass. Mask panel 'Brush' -> 'Mask Settings' (one panel serves brush + eraser; header icon + Copy/Reset labels swap); stale 'separate eraser panel' note -> SPEC NOTE. Brush Count gets the app's 'x' unit. No-selection header icon -> palette. Asset summary / Layers row / Auto Glitter match unified to one anatomy (34px thumb, name 12/600, meta 11, 8px gap); surface follows container - module .asset keeps the sunk inset + text button, list rows stay carded + icon. Every browser 'Design' bar -> palette icon. Text 'Line' spacing shows % not a bare number. Confirmed app-accurate, no change: Canvas 'Replace' for the base image (assets stay 'Change'); Image Size Scale is a number field (rule 9) + Quick scale kept.

p18: Scope corrected - layers panel + Add-a-layer modal ARE in (visual parity only). Quick Add / modal tile copy now verbatim from LAYER_UI_CONFIG.addableViaModal; 'Glitter fill' -> 'Fill Layer'; subtext capped width. Project + Size (No selection) and Image/Canvas Size (Canvas Properties) are .formmod blocks: card-ground header + footer, panel-ground fields; group labels dropped where the module name carries it (rule A). Shared-Size caption is a SPEC NOTE. No-selection title 'Canvas' -> 'Design'; other panel titles stay (distinct panels).

p17: Layers panel icons bumped, list gap 4->6 (matches block gap). Auto Glitter Color Matches rebuilt to look like a Layers row (bordered card, swatch-pair thumbnail, name + match%, Change icon). Asset browser nav header is one component: Back always present (disabled+faded at root, reserving its slot), title, BARE count number. Panel Y2K title is Design in every browser view. Corner badges unified (animated glyph + font System/language marker, one ~14px pill). Filter drawer Search-by-name-only is a toggle switch now. Canvas Properties two-states caption is a dashed SPEC NOTE box.

p16: wrote docs/PANEL-REDESIGN-SPEC.md (the build spec). Labels 11px. Segmented text 11. Texture->Offset relabel. Fit-box-to-text in a card footer, Box mode only. Multi-select drops Merge down. Add-layer modal + Quick Add share one taller tile. Auto Glitter status fixed height. Canvas Scale format matches Transform.

p15: booleans are ONE toggle switch everywhere (label left, switch right-aligned to the value column). Full-width buttons / footers / assets. Add-layer modal. Reset-icon button fix.

p14: Auto Glitter wizard (scroll + sticky footer). Layers panel. Workspace start card. Credit block rebuilt. Text moved to the layer-panels page.

p13: footers for form submits (hairline + own padding). Empty + populated states both drawn and labelled. Browser layouts chosen by collection size.

p12: browser iteration; first-pass archive removed; frames + fps with fallbacks.

p11: read-before-implementing + handoff block. p10: state panels. p9: revert column narrowed to rows only. p8: re-grounded 4 panels; concentric radii. p7: Transform Align split; one row grid. p6: module-header revert present-only. p5: X/Y/W/H/Scale are number fields; Placement a dropdown. p4: even --pad, one gap. p3: Fill is a paint slot; font picker is preview cards.
